definitions.explanation: A prefix indicating something is Japanese or in Japanese style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stay in a Japanese-style room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和服|わふく}→和服：04094_wafuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a photo wearing Japanese clothes.

notes:
{和|わ}〜 is a prefix meaning 'Japanese' or 'Japanese-style.'

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧: Japanese food/cuisine
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style room (with tatami)
- ⟦{和服|わふく}→和服：04094_wafuku⟧: Japanese clothing (kimono, etc.)
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧: Japanese style
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧: Japanese sweets
- ⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧: Japanese paper (washi)
- ⟦{和英|わえい}→和英：05253_waei⟧: Japanese-English (⟦{和英辞典|わえいじてん}→和英辞典：24664_waeijiten⟧)
- ⟦{和楽器|わがっき}→和楽器：05231_wagakki⟧: Japanese instruments

CONTRAST WITH {洋|よう}〜:
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ ↔ ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Japanese ↔ Western food)
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧ ↔ ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧ (Japanese ↔ Western room)
- ⟦{和服|わふく}→和服：04094_wafuku⟧ ↔ ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧ (Japanese ↔ Western clothes)
